title: R5Reloaded / Apex Season 3
status: Public-source interpretation; native engine internals partially opaque

sources.title: Supported Apex Season 3 build
sources.claim: The SDK targets R5pc_r5launch_N1094_CL456479_2019_10_30_05_20_PM and requires existing game executables.

sources.title: CServer declaration
sources.claim: Exposes server state, tick count and interval, client storage, capacity, map, and dedicated-server status.

sources.title: CClient declaration
sources.claim: Server-side client records distinguish user ID, Nucleus identity, channel, sign-on stage, fake-client flag, and replication ticks.

sources.title: Network channel declaration
sources.claim: Exposes endpoint, sequence and acknowledgement state, message handling, and reliable/unreliable streams.

sources.title: Input command declaration
sources.claim: Exposes sequence, tick, command time, movement, buttons, view angles, and frame time; unknown fields remain.

sources.title: Command-processing wrapper
sources.claim: The SDK can decline command processing based on a movement-time budget, then delegates accepted processing to the binary.

sources.title: Partial snapshot declaration
sources.claim: A partial recovered layout includes tick-update data and entity-oriented buffers. Most fields remain unidentified.

sources.title: Snapshot-send wrapper
sources.claim: The visible snapshot wrapper forwards to CClient__SendSnapshot; it is not the complete emission implementation.

sources.title: Server listing record
sources.claim: Listing fields include visibility, map, playlist, endpoint, compatibility data, network-key data, and player counts.

sources.title: Pylon API client
sources.claim: Visible client methods query listings, find hidden servers by token, and post host listings. The directory service implementation is not present in this inspected code.

sources.title: Server-frame wrapper
sources.claim: RunFrame forwards to a recovered binary function pointer; the simulation body remains opaque.

sources.title: Game-state script
sources.claim: SetGameState updates level game state, signals changes, updates a server variable, and invokes callbacks.

sources.title: Bleedout predicate
sources.claim: The script checks the player bleedout state. Downed status is distinct from the alive predicate.

sources.title: Elimination registry
sources.claim: Elimination is tracked by platform UID in an EliminatedPlayers map, with a name and team record, and may be cleared.

sources.title: Respawn script
sources.claim: This path clears elimination and passes the same player reference to DecideRespawnPlayer_Retail. The native respawn implementation remains opaque.

sources.title: Survival-mode rules
sources.claim: The survival script uses team relationships, game states, and a playlist setting to decide whether bleedout is enabled.

sources.title: Downing script
sources.claim: The downing path changes player bleedout state and starts related behavior and callbacks.

constraints: Platform UID, slot index/current user ID, entity handle, and network-channel identity are distinct. Reconnect and slot reuse must not silently merge them.
Source-supported distinction; temporal identity rules inferred
The count of active/admitted clients must respect the configured maximum. Static slot storage is not the current lobby population.
Fake-client slots need not have a remote application, network channel, or real platform account. Do not fabricate account identities for bots.
ActiveClientSlot corresponds to sign-on state FULL. It says nothing about whether the assigned player is alive or downed.
An assignment, participant, assigned entity, and squad must refer to the same game session. The game-session identity boundary remains inferred.
ReadyPlayer means alive and not bleeding out; DownedPlayer means alive and bleeding out. Dead or observer entities may be in neither phase.
Elimination status is scoped by game session and platform identity. Registry membership, not an entity-only health predicate, determines EliminatedIdentity.
The inspected respawn path clears elimination and reuses a player reference. This supports script-level continuity, but does not prove native allocation or reconnect continuity.
A received command can be declined by the movement-time wrapper. CommandProcessing denotes accepted native execution; it does not guarantee a particular gameplay outcome.
Do not impose one snapshot per frame or full-world contents from these declarations. Tick, frame, and snapshot-send interfaces are partially opaque.
Listing lookup is discovery, not skill matchmaking or game admission. Hidden/public classify the listing’s hidden field; offline means no publication.
Every source assertion applies to the pinned repositories supporting the named Season 3 build. Flowstate behavior can differ from original retail gameplay.
unknowns: Native bodies behind RunFrame, SendSnapshot, RunCommand, and native respawn calls.
Unknown SDK layout fields and declarations explicitly marked unconfirmed.
Directory-service implementation, its internal persistence, and publication lifecycle.
Exact match/session identity, reconnect ownership, and slot/avatar reuse invariants.
Original retail versus community changes; current EA matchmaking is outside this R5 model.

classes.name: GameServer
classes.description: An identified engine-side server resource, distinct from its hosting process and gameplay occurrences.
classes.rationale: An identified engine-side server resource, distinct from its hosting process and gameplay occurrences.

classes.name: GameSession
classes.description: A conceptual identity for the current level and game roster. No literal match ID was recovered; the boundary is a modeling hypothesis.
classes.rationale: A conceptual identity for the current level and game roster. No literal match ID was recovered; the boundary is a modeling hypothesis.

questions.question: What preserves a game session's identity?
questions.why: The SDK declarations do not establish reconnect or match-boundary behavior.
questions.resolve: Inspect lifecycle callers and compare reconnect, map-change, and match-restart traces.

classes.name: PlaylistConfig
classes.description: A mode configuration artifact used by server and gameplay scripts; the exact file and override lifecycle is not reconstructed.
classes.rationale: A mode configuration artifact used by server and gameplay scripts; the exact file and override lifecycle is not reconstructed.

classes.name: PlatformIdentity
classes.description: An identity distinguished by a platform/persona UID. Slot-local user IDs do not supply this identity. Real identities and placeholder bot IDs must be distinguished.
classes.rationale: An identity distinguished by a platform/persona UID. Slot-local user IDs do not supply this identity. Real identities and placeholder bot IDs must be distinguished.

classes.name: ClientApplication
classes.description: The remote game application as a runtime resource. Its process structure is abstracted rather than equated with CClient.
classes.rationale: The remote game application as a runtime resource. Its process structure is abstracted rather than equated with CClient.

classes.name: DirectoryService
classes.description: The opaque Pylon service endpoint reached by the SDK API client. Its internal objects, storage, and deployment are unresolved.
classes.rationale: The opaque Pylon service endpoint reached by the SDK API client. Its internal objects, storage, and deployment are unresolved.

classes.name: ServerListing
classes.description: An identified advertisement information artifact describing a game server. It is separate from the server it describes.
classes.rationale: An identified advertisement information artifact describing a game server. It is separate from the server it describes.

classes.name: PublishedListing
classes.description: A listing currently published through the directory service. Publication identity and lifecycle are conceptual abstractions.
classes.rationale: A listing currently published through the directory service. Publication identity and lifecycle are conceptual abstractions.

classes.name: ListingPublication
classes.description: The time-bounded publication relationship between a directory service and an advertised listing.
classes.rationale: The time-bounded publication relationship between a directory service and an advertised listing.

classes.name: HiddenListing
classes.description: A listing whose intrinsic hidden field is true; retrieval can use a token. Offline hosting is the absence of a publication, not a listing phase.
classes.rationale: A listing whose intrinsic hidden field is true; retrieval can use a token. Offline hosting is the absence of a publication, not a listing phase.

classes.name: PublicListing
classes.description: A listing whose intrinsic hidden field is false.
classes.rationale: A listing whose intrinsic hidden field is false.

classes.name: ListingUpdate
classes.description: An occurrence submitting host-listing data through PostServerHost; it may create or refresh an advertisement.
classes.rationale: An occurrence submitting host-listing data through PostServerHost; it may create or refresh an advertisement.

classes.name: ServerLookup
classes.description: An occurrence querying a server list or looking up a listing by token. It does not itself establish a game connection.
classes.rationale: An occurrence querying a server list or looking up a listing by token. It does not itself establish a game connection.

classes.name: ClientSlot
classes.description: A server-owned CClient resource/slot, reused across connection lifecycles. Neither the remote application nor an enduring player identity.
classes.rationale: A server-owned CClient resource/slot, reused across connection lifecycles. Neither the remote application nor an enduring player identity.

classes.name: SessionParticipant
classes.description: A client slot currently admitted to a game session. Continuity across reconnect or slot reuse is not presumed.
classes.rationale: A client slot currently admitted to a game session. Continuity across reconnect or slot reuse is not presumed.

classes.name: SessionParticipation
classes.description: The current relationship between an admitted slot and one session. Historical player results require separate records.
classes.rationale: The current relationship between an admitted slot and one session. Historical player results require separate records.

classes.name: ActiveClientSlot
classes.description: A slot with sign-on state FULL, matching CClient::IsActive; this is distinct from avatar life state.
classes.rationale: A slot with sign-on state FULL, matching CClient::IsActive; this is distinct from avatar life state.

classes.name: NetworkChannel
classes.description: A CNetChan communication resource with endpoint and sequencing state. It can exist before a player entity is active.
classes.rationale: A CNetChan communication resource with endpoint and sequencing state. It can exist before a player entity is active.

classes.name: ClientReplicationState
classes.description: Slot-specific replication/command state, modeled as an intrinsic mode rather than another player identity.
classes.rationale: Slot-specific replication/command state, modeled as an intrinsic mode rather than another player identity.

classes.name: PlayerEntity
classes.description: An identified player character entity. Script-level respawn can reuse its reference; native allocation and lifetime details remain unresolved.
classes.rationale: An identified player character entity. Script-level respawn can reuse its reference; native allocation and lifetime details remain unresolved.

classes.name: AssignedPlayerEntity
classes.description: A player entity assigned to a session participant; this role also permits fake-client participants.
classes.rationale: A player entity assigned to a session participant; this role also permits fake-client participants.

classes.name: AvatarAssignment
classes.description: The control relationship between one session participant and one assigned player entity. Exact allocation lifecycle is a hypothesis.
classes.rationale: The control relationship between one session participant and one assigned player entity. Exact allocation lifecycle is a hypothesis.

classes.name: MatchSquad
classes.description: A session-scoped team/roster abstraction grounded in team numbers and team-based script operations.
classes.rationale: A session-scoped team/roster abstraction grounded in team numbers and team-based script operations.

classes.name: ReadyPlayer
classes.description: A living player entity not in bleedout, using intrinsic life and bleedout state. This does not assert combat eligibility under every temporary effect.
classes.rationale: A living player entity not in bleedout, using intrinsic life and bleedout state. This does not assert combat eligibility under every temporary effect.

classes.name: DownedPlayer
classes.description: A living player entity in bleedout. Alive and downed are not mutually exclusive raw engine predicates.
classes.rationale: A living player entity in bleedout. Alive and downed are not mutually exclusive raw engine predicates.

classes.name: EliminatedIdentity
classes.description: A platform identity with a current elimination status in this session. Source evidence is keyed by UID rather than entity life state.
classes.rationale: A platform identity with a current elimination status in this session. Source evidence is keyed by UID rather than entity life state.

classes.name: EliminationStatus
classes.description: The session-specific elimination relationship of a platform identity. The source implements its registry as information records.
classes.rationale: The session-specific elimination relationship of a platform identity. The source implements its registry as information records.

classes.name: GameMatch
classes.description: The gameplay occurrence associated with a conceptual game session; not a literal SDK class.
classes.rationale: The gameplay occurrence associated with a conceptual game session; not a literal SDK class.

classes.name: ServerFrame
classes.description: One invocation of the visible server-frame entry point. Full simulation semantics are delegated to the binary.
classes.rationale: One invocation of the visible server-frame entry point. Full simulation semantics are delegated to the binary.

classes.name: InputCommand
classes.description: An action-request information artifact represented by CUserCmd. Receiving it does not imply that it was processed.
classes.rationale: An action-request information artifact represented by CUserCmd. Receiving it does not imply that it was processed.

classes.name: CommandProcessing
classes.description: An accepted movement-command execution passed to the native processor. Attempts rejected by the wrapper are distinct.
classes.rationale: An accepted movement-command execution passed to the native processor. Attempts rejected by the wrapper are distinct.

classes.name: Snapshot
classes.description: A partially understood server-state information artifact; recovered CFrameSnapshot layout does not establish a complete world-state semantics.
classes.rationale: A partially understood server-state information artifact; recovered CFrameSnapshot layout does not establish a complete world-state semantics.

questions.question: Does each snapshot represent a complete world state?
questions.why: The declarations expose snapshot sending but leave its native contents opaque.
questions.resolve: Inspect authorized native implementation or documented replication behavior before tightening its counts.

classes.name: SnapshotEmission
classes.description: An invocation of the snapshot-send interface for one client slot. The actual encoding and emission body is not available here.
classes.rationale: An invocation of the snapshot-send interface for one client slot. The actual encoding and emission body is not available here.

classes.name: Respawn
classes.description: An occurrence restoring an existing script-referenced player entity, potentially clearing its platform identity’s elimination status.
classes.rationale: An occurrence restoring an existing script-referenced player entity, potentially clearing its platform identity’s elimination status.

classes.name: Downing
classes.description: An occurrence entering player bleedout, distinct from eliminating a platform identity.
classes.rationale: An occurrence entering player bleedout, distinct from eliminating a platform identity.

classes.name: GameStateChange
classes.description: An occurrence of SetGameState for the current level/game context.
classes.rationale: An occurrence of SetGameState for the current level/game context.
